title: Patch and triage vulnerable production dependency versions
expected_value: Flagship golden-workflow reliability; scores are planning estimates, not health metrics.
test_requirements: Reproduce on isolated exact source; preserve baseline/fixed evidence, appropriate build/tests and golden path; source reading is not interactive sign-off.
source_evidence: npm audit --omit=dev on the isolated lockfile found direct next@16.3.3 critical and transitive sharp high/source-map-js high advisories.
Direct Next advisory includes next/og ImageResponse RCE affected below 16.3.6; additional Next advisories affect through below 16.3.8.
Source directly imports next/headers and next/navigation for Vinext-backed runtime; direct next/og import was not found.
next_action: Determine whether affected server paths are deployed/reachable, patch to fixed versions in an isolated branch, and rerun build/test/security gates.
